data_objects.name: intraday_market_bars
data_objects.meaning: Intraday open-high-low-close and volume bars for an unidentified traded instrument.
data_objects.notes: Clock times recur across session-like runs, but no date or session identifier is provided.

variables.name: Time
variables.meaning: Clock time labeling the intraday bar.

variables.name: Volume
variables.meaning: Traded volume associated with the bar.

structure.description: Each row is an intraday OHLCV bar; within a session-like run, Time advances in approximately one-minute increments.
Time values repeat and the clock sequence resets, so Time is not a table-wide key and distinct runs cannot be aligned to dates from this table alone.

uncertainties: The traded instrument, exchange, calendar date, time zone, and session identity are not supplied.
The price currency, volume basis, and whether Time marks bar start or bar end are unspecified.
annotation_notes: The semantic map uses only the declared train.csv table.
